title: About | FinishLines Creative Concepts
description: A family-driven fabrication and upholstery shop in Apopka, Florida, built on craftsmanship, creativity and precision.

blocks.headline:
More than
just a shop
blocks.intro: FLCC is a family-driven business built on craftsmanship, creativity and precision. What started as a passion for rebuilding cars and boats grew into an established local business.

blocks.headline:
We do the whole
job ourselves
paragraphs: Most shops do one thing. If you need a boat's interior rebuilt and a new tower fabricated and the hardware coated, you're usually managing three vendors, three schedules and three people blaming each other.
We cut and weld the metal, stitch the upholstery, and coat the finish, in the same building, by the same people. One quote, one timeline, one shop answering the phone.
It also means the trades talk to each other. The person building your frame knows what the upholsterer needs from it, because they're ten feet apart.

cards.title: Nothing leaves the building
cards.text: No subcontractors. Every stage of the job happens here, which is why the finish matches across the metal and the vinyl.

cards.title: No job too small
cards.text: A single torn cushion is as welcome as a full pontoon rebuild. Small repairs are how most of our long relationships started.

cards.title: Built for Florida
cards.text: Marine-grade materials and corrosion-resistant finishes, because sun, salt and afternoon storms are the real test here.

cards.title: You talk to the builder
cards.text: The person who quotes your job is the person who builds it. Nothing gets lost between a salesperson and a shop floor.

blocks.headline:
Boats, mostly.
But not only.
blocks.text: Marine work is the backbone: pontoons, bass boats, deck boats, center consoles. Around that sits everything else a metal-and-fabric shop gets asked for.

items.title: Marine upholstery & fabrication
items.text: Full interiors, helm seating, bench rebuilds, aluminium towers, T-tops, leaning posts, consoles and tanks.

items.title: Vehicle interiors
items.text: Classic car restorations, ATV and side-by-side seats, motorhome and RV interiors. Diamond stitch a speciality.

items.title: Gates, railings & architectural metal
items.text: Driveway gates, fence panels, handrails, stair and walkway railings, gangways.

items.title: Signs & cut metal art
items.text: CNC plasma-cut signage and medallions: ranch entrances, business signs, family pieces.

items.title: Powder coating
items.text: Wheels, frames, railings and hardware, blasted and cured in-house.
